options.name: Progression Balancing
options.doc:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.
options.doc_html:

Un réglage plus bas signifie qu'il reste coincé. Un réglage plus élevé signifie moins se coincer.

options.name: Accessibility
options.doc:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

**Full:** ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

**Minimal:** ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.
options.doc_html:

options.name: Extra Shines
options.doc:
How many extra shine sprites you want added to the pool. This is a percentage so it ranges from 0 to 90
If more shines would be added than locations possible it will add as many as it can
options.doc_fr: Combien de sprites supplémentaires vous voulez ajouter à la piscine. Il s'agit d'un pourcentage de sorte qu'il varie de 0 à 90 Si plus de brillances seraient ajoutées que les emplacements possibles, il en ajoutera autant que possible

options.name: Death Link
options.doc: When you die, everyone who enabled death link dies. Of course, the reverse is true too.
options.doc_html: When you die, everyone who enabled death link dies. Of course, the reverse is true too.
options.doc_fr: Quand vous mourez, tous ceux qui ont permis la mort meurent. Bien sûr, l'inverse est vrai aussi.
options.doc_html_fr: Quand vous mourez, tous ceux qui ont permis la mort meurent. Bien sûr, l'inverse est vrai aussi.

options.name: Level Access
options.doc:
If on "vanilla", the main levels are accessed in the way they are in the base game (e.g. Ricco Harbor is accessible after collecting 3 Shine Sprites).
If on "tickets", each level has a ticket item that must be acquired to access the level.
To reduce generation failures in testing, you'll automatically receive one free ticket at the start.

options.name: Difficulty
options.doc:
This enables difficulty settings. Higher difficulty settings will include checks in logic that normally
are not possible without doing difficult or unintended things. This includes spraying things with different
nozzles, doing difficult platforming, and executing glitches.

options.name: All Shines Selectable
options.doc:
Enables you to select every shine without having to complete each in order.
You will still need access to each hub (Gelato Beach, Noki Bay, Pinna Park, etc.)
options.doc_fr:
Permet de sélectionner chaque brillance sans avoir à compléter chacune dans l'ordre.
Vous aurez toujours besoin d'accès à chaque hub (Gelato Beach, Noki Bay, Pinna Park, etc.)

options.name: Starting Nozzle
options.doc:
If on, you will start with no Spray Nozzle, and in fact, no FLUDD at all. (Still in non-enforce mode)
You will skip directly to Delfino Plaza, and the first Airstrip mission will be removed from locations.
In this early version of this setting, you are expected to spray unusual things with Hover.

options.name: Enable 100 Coin Shines
options.doc:
Turn off to ignore the 100 coin Shine Sprites, which removes 8 Shine Sprites from the pool.
You can still collect them, but they don't do anything.

options.name: Enable Nozzle Boxes
options.doc: Enables Nozzle Boxes as a location.
options.doc_fr: Active les Boites Buses comme un emplacement.

options.name: Corona Mountain Shines
options.doc:
How many Shine Sprites are required to access Corona Mountain and the Delfino Airstrip revisit.
If this is more than the locations available, This will be automatically adjusted to 90-80% of locations available
after all other progression items are created / accounted for.
options.doc_fr:
Combien de Shine Sprites sont nécessaires pour accéder au mont Corona et à la piste d'atterrissage de Delfino revisite.
Si c'est plus que les emplacements disponibles, ceci sera automatiquement ajusté à 90-80% des emplacements disponibles après que tous les autres éléments de progression sont créés / comptabilisés.

options.name: Blue Coinsanity
options.doc:
Full shuffle: adds Blue Coins to the pool and makes Blue Coins locations.
Trade Shines Only: Adds the trade shines from the boathouse. Will NOT add the blue coin locations though.
options.doc_fr:
Full shuffle: ajoute les pièces bleues à la piscine et fait des pièces bleues emplacements.
Trade Shines Only: Ajoute le trade brille du hangar à bateaux. Ne pas ajouter les emplacements de pièces bleues cependant.

options.name: Blue Coin Maximum
options.doc:
How many Blue Coins to include in the pool if Blue Coinsanity is on.
Does nothing if Blue Coinsanity full_shuffle is off.
Corresponding trade shines will be removed from locations.
Removed Blue Coins will be replaced by other items in the pool, such as filler, to fill the
    remaining Blue Coin locations.
Example: You only want 220 of the 240 possible blue coins, the other 20 spots will be filled by other items.
options.doc_fr:
Combien de pièces bleues à inclure dans la piscine si Blue Coins est sur.
Ne fait rien si Blue Coinsanity full shuffle est éteint.
Les brillances commerciales correspondantes seront retirées des emplacements.
Les pièces bleues supprimées seront remplacées par d'autres articles dans la piscine, comme le remplissage, pour remplir les autres emplacements de pièces bleues.
Example: Vous ne voulez que 220 des 240 pièces bleues possibles, les 20 autres taches seront remplies par d'autres articles.

options.name: Trade Shine Maximum
options.doc:
The number of Shines from the boathouse trades that will be shuffled. If the Blue Coin Maximum is not enough
to obtain this amount, it will decrease automatically.
Keep in mind that if this value is too high, there is a chance you will have to nearly 100% the game.
